Features: 📸 Photo to answer — instant AI explanations 🧠 Smart flashcards & quizzes 📚 Categories: Math, History, Literature & more 🎯 Study mode with up to 6 images Built by an 18-year-old solo developer from Uzbekistan 🇺🇿

records.name: 皮球侠
records.tagline: 3 AI replies for any awkward workplace message, instantly
records.description: Stuck on a difficult message from your boss or colleague? Paste what they said, and PiQiuXia generates 3 ready-to-send replies in seconds — buy time, clarify responsibility, or escalate smartly. Built for Asian workplace culture. Free to try.

records.name: Agentique
records.tagline: Free tools for packaging and validating AI agent resources
records.description: Agentique is a free, open-source toolkit for packaging, validating, and sharing AI agent resources. It includes public schemas, a validator, starter examples, a GitHub Action, and readback tooling so developers can inspect resources before reuse. The project is fully free and open source. The goal is not to build a closed marketplace, but to create a practical, auditable toolkit that developers and creators can inspect, use, and improve together.

records.name: SupervisorMatch
records.tagline: AI that matches students with funded professors worldwide.
records.description: SupervisorMatch helps students and researchers find their ideal PhD or Postdoctoral supervisor anywhere in the world. Using AI algorithms and expert academic review, we match your CV and research interests with professors who have active funding and aligned research areas, delivering personalized supervisor recommendations directly to your inbox.

records.name: RewardIQ - Stop leaving rewards behind
records.tagline: Find and use the money you're leaving behind
records.description: RewardIQ replaces expensive SaaS hosting, heavy database servers, and paid cron managers with a single, serverless architecture that costs flat zero to operate. Running completely on free Google infrastructure and static hosting, the platform maps user profiles to live AI logic proxies via OpenRouter, catches real-time Stripe webhooks to transpile custom HTML-to-PDF reports inside 60 seconds, and uses a background onboarding trigger to route high-value leads into premium consulting.

records.name: Meltflex AI Availible on App Store
records.tagline: We have launched on app store and google play store
records.description: MeltFlex AI is now on iOS. Snap a photo of any room, empty or furnished, and the AI redesigns it in seconds with real furniture from IKEA, Amazon, Wayfair, Pottery Barn & Ashley. Every piece is a real product with real pricing, so you can compare across stores and buy directly. Upload a floor plan and get an interactive 3D model. Try unlimited styles, no designer needed. Free to start. The full MeltFlex experience now fits in your pocket.

records.name: Aurelle
records.tagline: Your AI stylist — knows your body, colours & wardrobe
records.description: Aurelle learns your body shape, colour palette, and personal style — then styles you every morning from clothes you already own. → Daily outfits tailored to your weather, calendar, and mood → Plan your whole week — no repeats, weather-aware → Travel packing — day-by-day outfit plans, minimal suitcase → "Will it fit?" — snap a photo of any item and see how it works with your wardrobe before you buy Built in Frankfurt by a husband-and-wife team. GDPR-native. Launching May 31 across 6 EU markets.

records.name: Ewbly
records.tagline: AI Chatbot for Indian Businesses — Trained on Your PDFs
records.description: Ewbly lets Indian businesses build an AI chatbot from their PDFs and website in under 5 minutes — no code needed. Unlike Chatbase or SiteGPT, Ewbly is built for India: INR pricing, UPI payments, Hindi & regional language support, and IST customer support. Free plan available. Embed on WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or any site with one script tag.

records.name: FilesFlow
records.tagline: Merge, compress, convert PDFs. Resize, crop, compress images
records.description: Merge, split, compress, and convert PDFs. Resize, crop, and compress images. Convert documents to PDF. Rephrase text with AI and detect AI-generated content. 25+ tools, completely free.

records.name: Website Audit Tool
records.tagline: Get an AI powered SEO audit in under 60 seconds
records.description: Audit is a free AI powered SEO audit tool designed to help website owners, marketers, freelancers, and businesses uncover hidden SEO issues in seconds. Simply enter a website URL to receive actionable insights on technical SEO, performance, on page optimization, and opportunities to improve visibility. Instead of spending hours manually auditing a website, get a clear overview of what may be holding your site back and where to focus your efforts next.

records.name: Messages Export Pro
records.tagline: Export Messages from Mac to PDF, CSV, and TXT
records.description: Messages Export Pro lets you export iMessage, SMS, MMS, and RCS conversations from your Mac into PDF, CSV, or TXT files. Save attachments, create searchable exports, and keep message data private with fully local processing—no iPhone backup or cloud upload required. Perfect for backups, legal records, compliance, and data analysis.

records.name: Flashback Booth
records.tagline: A 100% private, browser-based retro photo booth
records.description: Step back in time with a digital retro photo experience. Capture photo strips, apply classic film filters, and add custom date stamps all processed 100% locally in your browser for total privacy. No sign-ups, just instant nostalgic memories.

records.name: SaaSRove
records.tagline: SaaS Products Directory
records.description: Find curated SaaS products across CRM, marketing, analytics, finance, productivity, automation, deals, and founder resources.

records.name: Logic Layer
records.tagline: Code Your Vision Into Reality
records.description: Logic Layer Pvt. Ltd. is a software company focused on building modern business software solutions that help companies streamline operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate growth. We specialize in ERP systems, business automation software, SaaS platforms, custom business applications, and enterprise web solutions tailored for businesses of all sizes.

records.name: SAVEIONS LTD
records.tagline: Drive Stronger, Cleaner, and More Efficiently
records.description: Upgrade your car with a hydrogen generator kit. Save 15–20% fuel, boost engine power by 25%, and cut emissions with a safe, eco-friendly HHO Car Kit. H2 SAVEIONS LTD’s cutting-edge Hydrogen Generator for Cars will revolutionise your driving experience. This kit’s precision computer control and PEM water electrolysis technology help boost engine power, reduce harmful emissions, and improve fuel economy, all while maintaining the safety and dependability of your car.

records.name: UniSplit
records.tagline: Split bills instantly with AI receipt scanning. No more math
records.description: Say goodbye to manual math after group trips and dinners. UniSplit uses advanced AI to scan messy, crumpled, or foreign receipts in seconds. Instantly itemize, split, and settle up with friends. Split the bill, not the vibe.

records.name: Shishin
records.tagline: Ranked US-stock setups from a four-engine quant system
records.description: Shishin publishes a ranked list of US-stock setups every morning before the open - from a four-engine quant system that switches behaviour with the market regime. Judged on return, Sharpe *and* drawdown. Research, not advice. Free in beta.

records.name: DecisionMesh
records.tagline: Every AI decision — governed, audited, compliant
records.description: DecisionMesh is the AI Intent Control Plane for enterprises. Unlike observability tools that explain what happened after an AI request, DecisionMesh governs what is allowed before it reaches an LLM. Enforce intent-based policies, mask PII before transmission, maintain immutable audit trails, control budgets, and route across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and self-hosted models. Built for regulated industries where AI governance, compliance, and accountability are critical.

records.name: Gazettio
records.tagline: Turn your RSS feeds into a beautiful digital newspaper
records.description: Beautiful, distraction-free digital news reading.

records.name: BluePick
records.tagline: AI product research for Amazon sellers
records.description: BluePick helps Amazon and ecommerce sellers find better product opportunities and create product images faster. It combines Amazon sample data, ASIN analysis, image search, cross-market checks, Google Trends references, and AI insights to help sellers decide what to research, test, or avoid. BluePick Studio lets users upload product photos and generate Amazon-style main images, lifestyle scenes, comparison images, and A+ reference visuals.

records.name: TinyURL - Free URL Shortener Tool
records.tagline: Free URL Shortener & Link Clicks Tracker
records.description: Free URL shortener with advanced analytics. Shorten long URLs instantly, track clicks, QR code generator, and share links anywhere.

records.name: Valkence Community - Talk Internet
records.tagline: See and discuss what's happening in internet culture
records.description: The Valkence Discord community has arrived 🎉 A new space to discuss Charts, Predictions, and everything happening across music, internet culture, entertainment, and more 🔥 Connect with the community and talk about what’s moving in real time 💬

records.name: Fleetement
records.tagline: solution intelligente pour gérer votre activité de location
records.description: Logiciel pour les agences de location de voitures au Maroc: flotte, réservations, contrats, paiements. Conçu pour les agences. Basé à Casablanca.Essai gratuit

records.name: PogKit
records.tagline: In-browser toolkit for makers, and everyday utilities
records.description: PogKit is a privacy-friendly collection of 70+ browser-based tools, games, and utilities. It includes developer tools, file converters, image utilities, text tools, generators, calculators, and game analysis tools, with most processing handled locally in the browser.
